entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Mishra's apprentice and lover and a gifted artificer, inventor of the Transmogrants, who later founded the Conclave of Mages with Tawnos.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, whom Ashnod served as apprentice and lover.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's apprentice, for whom Ashnod developed a romantic partnership and with whom she founded a school of mages.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Mishra's brother who activates the Sylex and ascends to planeswalkerhood.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: An observer who described Ashnod as cruelly beautiful.

entities.name: Loran
entities.description: A woman who fled Terisia City with the sylex and was captured and interrogated by Ashnod.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: The pregnant queen of Kroog whom Ashnod helped protect.

entities.name: Qadir
entities.description: The Fallaji leader killed by Ashnod during the Fall of Kroog.

entities.name: Jarin
entities.description: A Fallaji war captain who disrespected Ashnod.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A Phyrexian demon who confronted Ashnod and Tawnos at Argoth.

entities.name: Staff of Zegon
entities.description: Ashnod's staff that kept Mishra's Maq Fawa at bay and drained life.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: A destructive artifact Ashnod took from Loran and passed to Tawnos.

entities.name: Transmogrants
entities.description: Artificial zombie thralls created by Ashnod's process.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: A school of mages and artificers Ashnod and Tawnos founded near Ronom Lake.

entities.name: Zegon
entities.description: The city that Ashnod represented and that submitted to the Fallaji.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: The city that fell to dragon engines.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: The island where the final battle and Sylex Blast took place.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The explosion that destroyed Argoth and both armies.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane of the Brothers' War.

events.summary: Ashnod sneaks into Mishra's camp to negotiate for Zegon and becomes his apprentice and lover; Zegon submits to the Fallaji.
events.quote: Mishra, his interest piqued, studied the staff, and they agreed she would become his apprentice. They also became lovers.

events.summary: At the Peace Summit at Korlinda the Qadir kills the Warlord of Kroog, and Ashnod weakens Urza's automaton to free the Qadir before the Fallaji flee.
events.quote: Ashnod used her Staff of Zegon to weaken it, forcing it to release the Qadir.

events.summary: During the Fall of Kroog, Tawnos frees Ashnod to protect Kayla, and Ashnod kills the Qadir with the staff and helps Tawnos and Kayla escape by boat.
events.quote: The Qadir himself she made sure to kill, draining his life with the staff such that he collapsed, bleeding.

events.summary: Ashnod develops transmogrants and is made general of a campaign to conquer Korlis, to the dismay of Fallaji war captains.
events.quote: Ashnod developed a method for creating transmogrants , artificial zombies

events.summary: A Korlisian army destroys the transmogrants, Ashnod retreats to Mishra's Fortress and is sent to Sarinth.
events.quote: the transmogrants were all destroyed, and Ashnod had to retreat.

events.summary: Ashnod wounds and captures Loran near the Colekgan Mountains, takes the sylex and interrogates her in Almaaz.
events.quote: Near the Colekgan Mountains , Ashnod wounded and captured Loran, and relieved her of the sylex.

events.summary: Loran escapes in 57 AR without the Sylex, and Ashnod follows Mishra to Argoth.
events.quote: Ashnod decided to follow him there.

events.summary: At the Battle at Argoth Ashnod passes the sylex to Tawnos and holds off Gix while Urza activates it.
events.quote: Ashnod passed the sylex to Tawnos , who conveyed it to Urza while she held off the Phyrexian demon.

events.summary: The Sylex Blast destroys both armies and Argoth.
events.quote: The ensuing Sylex Blast destroyed both armies and the island of Argoth.

events.summary: Ashnod survives the blast, changes her appearance and name, and by 80 AR founds the Conclave of Mages with Tawnos as Nod.
events.quote: she had founded a school of mages and artificers near Ronom Lake with Tawnos.

relations.note: She developed a romantic partnership with him.
relations.quote: She developed a romantic partnership with Tawnos

relations.note: Drained his life with the staff during the Fall of Kroog.
relations.quote: The Qadir himself she made sure to kill, draining his life with the staff such that he collapsed, bleeding.
Her most famous creation was the process by which to create the metalloid thralls known as Transmogrants .
